title: PubMed (research)
description: Biomedical literature from PubMed as a research source, through gohort's built-in PubMed search: it finds the most relevant articles, then reads their titles, journals and dates.
setup_notes: The credential lands disabled: enable it under API Credentials. Get a free API key at ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/account (it raises PubMed's rate limit); the credential sends it as api_key. Run Test on its row under Admin > Extensions > Connectors, which makes one real search for a common phrase. Then add it under Admin > Extensions > Research Sources, which puts it to use: research asks it on the topics set there (suggested: medical, scientific), and a tool name there offers it to agents through query_source. Or pick it under Admin > Capabilities > Web Search as the engine.

questions.name: api_key
questions.label: NCBI API key
questions.help: Stored in the credential's secret store, never in the connector.

questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; research and Web Search list it by this name.
